name: Multi-City Mogul
description: Not content with one town? Prove you can run three markets at once. Win a controlling share of bread in three of the cities while growing a serious company — two rival chains will fight you in every aisle.

goals.description: Sell 40% of the bread bought in Metropolis (trailing three months) — the flagship market.
Sell 40% of the bread bought in Riverside — the mid-sized suburb.
Sell 40% of the bread bought in Portbay — the coastal working-class town.
Grow company value to $100M — a chain that wins share at a loss is not an empire.
